title: Pan-Seared Fish with Peruvian Stew Sauce
description: A delicious and flavorful dish combining the freshness of Pan-Seared Fish with the boldness of Peruvian Stew Sauce.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the vibrant olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the roasted garlic cloves and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fish fillets, skin side up (if they have skin), and sear for 2-3 minutes.
Flip the fish over and transfer the skillet to the preheated oven.
Bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, heat the Peruvian Stew Sauce in a separate saucepan over medium heat.
To serve, place the fish on a plate and spoon the Peruvian Stew Sauce over the top.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
